# painting.arts.narkive.com

> A community Q&A archive dedicated to painting, featuring discussions on art history, color theory, famous artworks, and artist biographies.

This site preserves discussions from Yahoo Answers about painting and visual art, covering topics from Renaissance masterpieces to contemporary techniques. It serves as a reference resource for art enthusiasts seeking information on famous paintings, artist identification, and practical painting instruction.

## Key Topics

- Color theory
- Painting techniques
- Famous paintings
- Art history
- Artist biography
- Georges Seurat
- Leonardo da Vinci
- Henri Matisse
- Picasso
- Monet
- Oil painting
- Acrylic painting
- Portrait painting
- Renaissance art
- Artwork identification

## Famous Paintings & Art History

- [where is the painting mona lisa?](https://painting.arts.narkive.com/naVo69Gc/where-is-the-painting-mona-lisa): Reference on Mona Lisa location at the Louvre in Paris by Leonardo da Vinci
- [DOES ANYBODY KNOW SOMETHING ABOUTTHE BIRTH OF VENUS by alexandre COLORS AND TEXTURE?](https://painting.arts.narkive.com/P9HdHFT9/does-anybody-know-something-aboutthe-birth-of-venus-by-alexandre-colors-and-texture): Analysis of Botticelli's Birth of Venus: colors, texture, and Renaissance technique
- [Who painted "Sunday in the park with George"?](https://painting.arts.narkive.com/VFw23wEM/who-painted-sunday-in-the-park-with-george): Q&A about Georges Seurat's Sunday Afternoon on Island of La Grande Jatte
- [what are the similarities of Picasso's paintings and Monet's?](https://painting.arts.narkive.com/FvVyqs7c/what-are-the-similarities-of-picasso-s-paintings-and-monet-s): Comparison of Picasso and Monet: Impressionism, Cubism, and painting techniques
- [how did Henri Matisse work relates to his life?](https://painting.arts.narkive.com/eDgk3RfQ/how-did-henri-matisse-work-relates-to-his-life): Analysis of Henri Matisse's life, work, and avant-garde painting techniques
- [Which American portrait artist painted each of the first five U.S. Presidents?](https://painting.arts.narkive.com/uSZFtMVt/which-american-portrait-artist-painted-each-of-the-first-five-u-s-presidents): Reference on Gilbert Stuart's presidential portraits of first five US Presidents
- [Fernando Botero nationality?](https://painting.arts.narkive.com/WZxxRA2v/fernando-botero-nationality): Reference on Colombian painter Fernando Botero from Medellin

## Color Theory & Fundamentals

- [how do you make brown?](https://painting.arts.narkive.com/ruMRgrxt/how-do-you-make-brown): Tutorial on color mixing brown using complementary colors and color theory
- [three dimensions of color?](https://painting.arts.narkive.com/mXbaQqTm/three-dimensions-of-color): Educational guide on hue, saturation, and value in color theory fundamentals
- [what dose oliveskin tone look like?.?](https://painting.arts.narkive.com/pihbXw63/what-dose-oliveskin-tone-look-like): Guide to olive skin tone in portrait painting and color undertones
- [What kind of colors are white, tan and beige?](https://painting.arts.narkive.com/be2v7hPr/what-kind-of-colors-are-white-tan-and-beige): Guide to neutral earth tones and color theory classification

## Painting Techniques & Materials

- [how can you make oil paint dry faster?](https://painting.arts.narkive.com/sNpiWjUV/how-can-you-make-oil-paint-dry-faster): Guide to oil paint drying techniques using Liquin and linseed oil mediums
- [Does anyone know what to use with acrylic paint to make it pop and change colors when it's struck by light?](https://painting.arts.narkive.com/BMArdA16/does-anyone-know-what-to-use-with-acrylic-paint-to-make-it-pop-and-change-colors-when-it-s-struck): Tutorial on interference colors and light-reflective effects in acrylic painting
